text: On the authority of Othman bin Affan - may God be pleased with him - he said when people said about him when he built the mosque of the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him: You have increased, and I heard the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, say: Whoever builds a mosque - Bukair said: I thought he said: seeking the face of God for it - God will build one like it in Paradise.
